battlecards.why_selected: Met or exceeded target prices from benchmark, agreed to tiered volume rebate, and allowed seamless continuation of supply chain with no clinical disruption.
battlecards.contract_terms: Addendum executed 7/19/2024; tiered volume-rebate schedule tied to annual spend; price caps for 12 months; automatic 1-year renewals unless cancelled with 60-day notice.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Competitive RFP created switching risk; benchmarking showed 15-46% SKU gaps; threat to award to Medline/Cardinal; consolidated enterprise-wide volume offered.
supplier_strengths: Existing ordering platform already integrated at 40+ sites
Willingness to match target pricing and provide rebates
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-training clinicians on new SKUs, formulary conversions, system integrations, and potential dual-inventory period.
battlecards.notes: Round-2 bid covered 99.8% of baseline SKUs with 20% savings; contract now live and savings tracking to plan.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Offered only 10% savings versus McKesson’s 20%; SKU coverage matched but pricing missed several target thresholds.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as credible alternative to pressure incumbent; offered direct-to-home model advantages.
supplier_weaknesses: Did not meet target price on high-spend SKUs
battlecards.notes: Kept engaged as fallback option should incumbent performance slip; potential for future spot buys.

battlecards.why_selected: Ability to restructure full-maintenance rates by mileage bucket with immediate savings and no disruption to existing leases.
battlecards.contract_terms: Service Agreement Addendum (pending execution) to lock new mileage-bucket rates through June 2026; quarterly reconciliation to actual miles; option to exit units with 30-day notice.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmark showed only 126 of 385 vehicles using maintenance each month; highlighted overpayment; threat to rebid or self-fund maintenance.
supplier_weaknesses: Initial rates set uniformly high regardless of utilization
battlecards.switching_costs: Would require buying out or reassigning ~400 active leases; driver reassignment and titling complexity.
battlecards.notes: Savings will be monitored via monthly bucket-level reporting once addendum is signed.

summary.skipped_reason: Office Supplies and Temp Labor still in data-collection phase; Pharmacy on hold; remaining suppliers lacked strategic detail.
